title: Review create index nonconcurrent
why: On PostgreSQL, a nonconcurrent index build blocks table writes until it completes.
suggestion: For a live PostgreSQL table, consider CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY in a migration that runs outside a transaction. Ordinary CREATE INDEX can be appropriate for initial schemas and transactional migrations.
limitations: Opt-in because transactional migration runners cannot use CONCURRENTLY.
Requires an explicit PostgreSQL path or postgres/postgresql language selection; portable SQL alone does not establish a PostgreSQL dialect.
Recognized non-PostgreSQL paths and SQLite, MySQL, or SQL Server source evidence prevent PostgreSQL-only advice.
